patch.status: Scratch-only; git apply --check passes against current throwing helper; no native build/test.
patch.change: Keep15-second initial readiness and4/8-second dismissal windows. Treat dismissal as Close absent/non-hittable AND exact frozen snapshot existing/hittable. Retry once only when Close is still hittable, throwing if not. After dismissal reveal the Share cancelled history and require it exists/hittable with Close still non-hittable before restart. Preserve post-relaunch frozen/unplaced/history assertions.
patch.falsePositivePrevention: Close merely covered by a banner cannot pass while the open panel covers the exact frozen snapshot. Blank or active modal covering that snapshot cannot satisfy its hittability. No saved cancellation history means explicit throw before restart. Snapshot exact label also rules out changed frozen contents. Offscreen retained AX alone is no longer mistaken for visible presentation.
patch.limits: Actual non-hittability of retained Close must be validated by root; if XCTest incorrectly reports it hittable, this still fails. No timeout extension, animation suppression, unrelated query fallback, app mutation, or cancellation inference. This patch cannot retroactively pass the original failed run.

review.constraints: Isolated copy only; media-only AVFoundation extraction, artifact/source reads and scratch patch. No shared changes, native app build/test/simulator operations, rerun, push or deployment.

rootFollowUp: Keep15s/4s/8s windows; require nonhittable Close, actionable exact underlying frozen snapshot, visible cancelled history before restart. No product behavior change.
